root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AltAddressKindsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.AltAddressKindsTbl ( AltAddressKindID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_AltAddressKindsTbl PRIMARY KEY, KindCode NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, KindName NVARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, CountsTowardTracking BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_AltAddressKinds_Tracking DEFAULT (1), SortOrder INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_AltAddressKinds_Sort DEFAULT (0), Enabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_AltAddressKinds_Enabled DEFAULT (1), CONSTRAINT UQ_AltAddressKinds_Code UNIQUE (KindCode) ); INSERT INTO dbo.AltAddressKindsTbl (KindCode, KindName, CountsTowardTracking, SortOrder, Enabled) VALUES (N'OnBehalf', N'On their behalf', 0, 10, 1), (N'Gift', N'As a gift', 0, 20, 1), (N'Home', N'Home', 1, 30, 1), (N'Work', N'Work', 1, 40, 1), (N'Friend', N'Friend', 1, 50, 1), (N'Family', N'Family', 1, 60, 1), (N'Other', N'Other', 1, 70, 1), (N'Sundry', N'Ad hoc', 0, 80, 1); END
